transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess things have just been a little difficult lately. I work at a front desk, and... I don't know, lately if a door slams, or even if someone just rolls a suitcase really fast across the lobby... I jump. 

It's just... it feels like it's happening again. It takes me a minute to get my heart back down. So... that's mainly what pushed me to come in.
Have you ever experienced or witnessed a traumatic event, such as an accident, violence, or something that made you fear for your safety?
Yeah... um, I guess so. There was an incident about two weeks ago. A guest... he, uh, he threatened me at the front desk. So... yeah, it's been going on since then.
Since the incident at work, have you had any unwanted memories, dreams, or feelings like you’re reliving the event?

Yeah... um, I guess so. Sometimes, just... out of nowhere, I'll get this picture in my head of him leaning over the counter. Like, knocking the equipment toward me. It happens even when I’m just... trying to answer a normal call. So... yeah.
Since the incident, have you found yourself avoiding certain people, places, or activities that remind you of what happened?

Um... yeah, I suppose. I've been, uh... taking the back hallway whenever I can. Just... walking past that exact spot in the lobby... I don't know, my chest gets kind of tight. I just want to get away from it, so... I try not to go through there.
